arrival.title: Welcome to Malaysia! 🇲🇾
arrival.subtitle: Your arrival information and next steps
arrival.importantNote: Our team member will be waiting for you at the airport to help you with your arrival. Please contact them using the information above when you arrive.

hostel.title: Settling Hostel
hostel.body: After arriving in Malaysia, you will need to settle into your hostel accommodation. This is where you will be staying during your studies.
list: Go to the hostel address provided by the university
Meet with the hostel manager or administrator
Complete the check-in process and receive your room key
Review the hostel rules and regulations
Set up your room and make it comfortable
hostel.important: Make sure to bring your passport and offer letter when checking in. Keep all your documents safe in a secure place.

activation.title: Student Activation
activation.body: Student activation is the process of registering yourself officially with the university. This makes you an active student at the university.
list: Visit the university's student services office or registration office
Bring all your documents (passport, offer letter, visa, etc.)
Get access to university systems and online portals
Set up your student email account
activation.important: This step is very important. You cannot attend classes or use university facilities until you complete student activation. Make sure to do this as soon as possible after arriving.

englishTest.title: English Placement Test
englishTest.body: The English Placement Test helps the university understand your English language level. This test decides which English classes you will take.
list: Check the university's schedule for the English placement test dates
Register for the test at the English language center or online portal
Prepare for the test by practicing English (reading, writing, listening, speaking)
Arrive on time on the test day with your student ID and passport
Complete the test (it usually takes 2-3 hours)
Wait for your results, which will tell you which English level class you will join
englishTest.important: Don't worry if you don't do perfectly. The test is just to find the right level for you. All students must take this test, even if English is your first language. The results help ensure you get the right English support during your studies.
